name: Kyuuka
source:
A Walking Tank pilot with silver hair and red eyes.
She seems to operate under Arimura’s orders, though which unit she belongs to remains unknown.
As a pilot, she possesses extraordinary skill and appears to command a squad of her own.

Her speech is polite, yet she constantly gives the impression of seeing through people’s hearts while looking down on them at the same time.

“Oh my, how unfortunate—it seems I’ve been disliked.”

[From [url=http://tech-gj.jp/products/hyakki/chara/index.html#kyuuka]official website[/url]]
